title: St. Louis Escape
specs: Immersive rooms with animations, special effects, and interactive storylines
Multiple rooms per escape game (3 to 6 rooms)
Escape rates range from 59% to 83% depending on the room
Must pay for at least four participants to book, but can play with fewer
Groups of minors must have at least one parent or guardian with them
The Cellar requires crawling through one section; not recommended for claustrophobia or panic disorders
No strobe lights but some blinking lights in The Cellar
Not wheelchair accessible; building has steep stairs
Do not bring weapons or outside items
Rooms are private for your group; no strangers added
includes: Use of escape room and puzzles
gap: Exact age minimums for each room except The Cellar (12+) not stated
blurb: Guests play private escape room games with immersive themes and special effects, lasting 60 minutes each. The facility also offers mini golf and a pinball arcade. Groups must book at least four participants but can play with fewer; all games are private with no strangers added.
extraNote: No refunds; cancellations with at least 24 hours notice receive credits for future bookings · 5 minute grace period; after 5 minutes game timer starts; more than 20 minutes late may require rescheduling · All bookings done online; walk-ins accepted if space available; credit cards only for walk-ins · Second floor of the building at 1420 S. 9th St., St. Louis, MO 63104
